from build123d import *

body_length = 80.0
body_diameter = 38.4
shoulder_length = 21.3
shoulder_diameter = 45.3
bore_diameter = 21.3
chamfer_size = 2.0

body_radius = body_diameter / 2.0
shoulder_radius = shoulder_diameter / 2.0
bore_radius = bore_diameter / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline((0, 0), (0, body_radius), (body_length - shoulder_length, body_radius),
                     (body_length - shoulder_length, shoulder_radius), (body_length, shoulder_radius),
                     (body_length, 0), close=True)
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.X)

solid_body = p.part
bore = Pos(body_length / 2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(bore_radius, body_length)
solid_body = solid_body - bore

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.X)[-1]
top_edges = top_face.edges()
solid_body = chamfer(top_edges, chamfer_size)

part = solid_body
part.name = "stepped_cylinder_with_bore"
export_step(part, "output.step")
